module: Explicit database-owned SECTION_MANAGER creation and erasure
coverage: 28 independent cases in each configuration: canonical creation/erasure/recreation across four supported profiles and both output transports, plus four native input/output combinations.

Creation uses one new handle, preserves explicit order and repetitions, installs reciprocal source root/soft-entry/reactor identity, retains root flags and copies caller collections. Retired manager snapshots remain inspectable after erasure.

Compatible existing CLASS declarations retain object identity, metadata and absent-count presence. Present counts become one on creation and zero on erasure. Conflicting declaration rejects atomically.

MoveNext, GetEnumerator and Dispose callbacks: enumeration/disposal failures are atomic; a caller-caught recursive creation poisons the outer attempt; callbacks removing requested sections reject without allocation and preserve caller side effects.

Foreign same-handle, detached, null and excessive members reject. Exact 65536 memberships succeed. Unsupported profiles, occupied case-insensitive anchors, orphan managers, exhausted handle range, changed source profile/reactors and foreign erase requests reject.

Actual ATTRIB XData 1005 pointers protect manager and typed owned extension descendants. Releasing pointers permits exact typed ownership cascade; referenced sections and containing INSERT remain registered.

A deliberately lowered private seed proves manager allocation reserves the live owner-held ATTRIB identity. The original valid global seed is restored after that assertion before unrelated legacy writer allocation; this does not claim general support for a manually corrupted global seed.
Native source LiveSection manager erase/recreate preserves original SECTION identities and old snapshots, assigns a fresh manager identity, and reloads requested membership and flag.
20 emitted DXFs per configuration audited with ezdxf 1.4.4: no errors or repairs. No native CAD runtime was available or claimed.

findings_fixed_before_frozen_candidate: Candidate allocation used ordinary GetObjectByHandle and omitted owner-held ATTRIB/ENDBLK identities; changed to StoredTableHandleTarget.
Compatible present CLASS count now updates on creation while absent count remains absent.
source_review.verifier_review: Read the owner lifecycle verifier; complete surviving-record comparisons for erase/recreate, exact root identity and native manager packet, with no additional normalization or identity-rewrite issue found.

initial_probe_failures: One initial fixture failure: leaving a deliberately lowered private seed active caused unrelated writer layout synthesis to collide with a live handle. Restoring the original valid seed after the targeted allocation assertion corrected the test; frozen production remained unchanged.
